cards.name: The Fool
cards.upright: A first step into the unknown. Trust the road, even if you can't see where it bends.
cards.reversed: A leap made without looking. Something you rushed past will catch up with you.

cards.name: The Magician
cards.upright: Everything you need is already in your hands. Use it.
cards.reversed: Clever tricks hide an empty purse. Someone is not what they claim.

cards.name: The High Priestess
cards.upright: Listen to the quiet voice. The answer is in what goes unsaid.
cards.reversed: A secret kept too long begins to rot.

cards.name: The Empress
cards.upright: Growth, comfort and plenty. Tend what you have and it will flourish.
cards.reversed: Too much of a good thing; something is being smothered.

cards.name: The Emperor
cards.upright: Order and a firm hand. Rules will serve you now.
cards.reversed: A rigid will cracks under pressure. Bend, or break.

cards.name: The Hierophant
cards.upright: Old ways and trusted teachers. Seek the counsel of those who came before.
cards.reversed: Tradition is a cage today. Question it.

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.upright: A bond that matters, and a choice that tests it.
cards.reversed: A rift between hearts, or between what you want and what you need.

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.upright: Victory through will. Hold the reins and charge.
cards.reversed: Pulled in two directions, you go nowhere.

cards.name: Strength
cards.upright: Quiet courage tames the wild beast. Gentleness is not weakness.
cards.reversed: Doubt gnaws at your resolve.

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.upright: Step away from the crowd. Clarity waits in solitude.
cards.reversed: Isolation has become hiding.

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
cards.upright: The wheel turns in your favor. Seize the moment while it lasts.
cards.reversed: The wheel turns against you. Brace yourself.

cards.name: Justice
cards.upright: What is owed will be paid, one way or another.
cards.reversed: The scales are rigged. Someone escapes what they deserve.

cards.name: The Hanged Man
cards.upright: Wait. Seen from upside down, the problem looks different.
cards.reversed: Stalling for nothing; the sacrifice was wasted.

cards.name: Death
cards.upright: An ending, and the room it makes for something new. Not always a grave.
cards.reversed: Clinging to what is already gone.

cards.name: Temperance
cards.upright: Balance and patience. Mix the waters slowly.
cards.reversed: Excess in one thing, starvation in another.

cards.name: The Devil
cards.upright: Chains you put on yourself. A temptation with a price.
cards.reversed: The chains loosen. You can walk away now.

cards.name: The Tower
cards.upright: Sudden upheaval. What was built on sand comes down.
cards.reversed: Disaster narrowly avoided, for now.

cards.name: The Star
cards.upright: Hope after the storm. Healing comes.
cards.reversed: Hope dims, but has not gone out.

cards.name: The Moon
cards.upright: Illusions and half-truths. Not everything that glimmers in the dark is real.
cards.reversed: The fog lifts; a deception is revealed.

cards.name: The Sun
cards.upright: Warmth, success and a clear sky. Things go your way.
cards.reversed: A cloud over a bright day; joy delayed, not denied.

cards.name: Judgement
cards.upright: A reckoning, and a calling. Answer it.
cards.reversed: You hear the call and pretend you didn't.

cards.name: The World
cards.upright: A circle closes. Something long worked for is complete.
cards.reversed: So close to the end, and one piece is missing.
